text: I hope this letter finds you well. I am writing to address a matter of concern regarding late payments and non-compliance with the agreed-upon terms outlined in our previous discussions. As you may be aware, there have been instances of late payments on the account associated with XXXX ..... Despite our mutual understanding and commitment to maintaining a timely payment schedule, it has come to my attention that there have been delays in meeting the specified deadlines. KIA FINANCE AMERICA XXXX .... In light of the above, I kindly request the removal of the late payment entries from our records. Clear communication and adherence to the agreed-upon terms are vital for the success of our partnership. I believe that resolving this matter promptly will contribute to the continued success of our business relationship. I value our business relationship and look forward to your prompt attention to this matter. Please feel free to contact me. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
